metadata.title: perf(tests): replace fixed sleeps with deterministic DOM waits in Playwright tests
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Replace ~180 hardcoded `wait_for_timeout()` calls and 42 `networkidle` waits with deterministic DOM-state waits across 19 Playwright test files
- Switch `_goto_admin` from networkidle-with-fallback to `domcontentloaded` (caller already waits for UI elements)
- Change retry backoff in `admin_utils.py` from linear to exponential with caps
- Remove ~70 redundant 300ms auth-type toggle waits (Alpine.js toggles synchronously; `expect()` already retries)
- Replace large fixed sleeps (4-5s) with HTMX loading indicator checks and `wait_for_selector` on DOM state
- Replace modal close/open waits with `wait_for_selector(hidden/visible)` and JS function readiness checks

## Test plan
- [x] Verify `make test-ui-headless` pass rate is equal or better than baseline
- [x] Confirm no new regressions introduced (all failures are pre-existing)
- [x] Verify timeout values are reasonable (5-15s caps, not too aggressive)

Closes #3336

commits.message:
perf(tests): replace fixed sleeps with deterministic DOM waits in Playwright tests

Replace ~180 hardcoded wait_for_timeout() calls and 42 networkidle waits
with deterministic DOM-state waits across the Playwright UI test suite.

Key changes:
- _goto_admin: networkidle-with-fallback → single domcontentloaded (caller
  already waits for UI elements)
- admin_utils retry backoff: linear 500ms×N → exponential min(100×2^n, cap)
- Remove ~70 × 300ms auth-type toggle waits (Alpine.js is synchronous,
  subsequent expect() already retries)
- Replace 5s fixed sleeps with HTMX loading indicator checks and
  wait_for_selector on DOM state
- Replace search debounce sleeps in main panels with
  wait_for_function on #TYPE-loading.htmx-request
- Replace networkidle in test_admin_url_context.py with domcontentloaded +
  networkidle fallback helper for HTMX content
- Replace modal close 300ms waits with wait_for_selector(hidden)
- Replace gateway modal open 500ms waits with JS function readiness check
- Keep wait_for_timeout for edit-modal search (debounce makes spinner
  detection unreliable) and Select All (async JS, no loading indicator)

Closes #3336

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
